subject: FinBridge intake: stakeholder confirmation, econ buyer & systems boundary
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finbridge.com>, security@finbridge.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinBridge — draft intake & quick confirm on stakeholders

Hi Asha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get the security intake moving: 

Summary of notes:
- Primary use: internal content assistant for customer support workflows (no PII enrichment).
- Data flow: customers send transcripts -> processed by service -> embeddings stored in a tenant bucket.
- Desired timeline: initial security review this month; procurement and licensing targeted by end of August.

Asks / next steps:
1) Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact — you mentioned procurement may own commercial, and CFO sign-off might be required. Can you confirm the names and best email(s)?
2) I attached a draft security questionnaire that we filled based on our call — please scan for anything missing and share a systems inventory if you have one.
3) Let's schedule a short (30m) security kickoff with your security and network folks next week — we can bring our security engineer (Rishi) and solutions lead (Marissa).

Attachments: finbridge_security_questionnaire_draft.pdf (draft answers)

If easier, you can reply with the stakeholder mapping and I’ll update our intake. Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finbridge.com, legal@finbridge.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinBridge — draft intake & quick confirm on stakeholders

Thanks Vanessa — appreciated the clear recap. A few points from our side: 

Stakeholders (tentative):
- Economic buyer: Priya Natarajan (CFO) <priya.natarajan@finbridge.com> — will require a short commercial briefing.
- Procurement/Contracts: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finbridge.com> — he handles template/legal redlines.
- Security contact: security@finbridge.com (cc’d) — they will own the SOC2 evidentiary follow-ups.
- Legal: legal@finbridge.com — for DPA / data residency clauses.

I attached a quick systems inventory export that lists the service endpoints we discussed (internal). A few clarifications: 
- We store transcripts in our EU tenant by default, but we can discuss token routing; can you confirm Redwood’s region/fallover options and KMS integrations?
- Procurement timeline: procurement needs vendor questionnaire and MSA redlines by Aug 18 to make our Q3 vendor cut-off. 

We can do the security kickoff on Wed 10 Aug at 10:00-10:30 PT — does that work for your team? Please loop in the technical person for network diagram review.

Attachment: finbridge_systems_inventory.csv

Thanks,
Asha

--
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Programs, FinBridge
asha.patel@finbridge.com | +1 646-555-7890

Subject: Re: FinBridge — draft intake & quick confirm on stakeholders

Great — thanks for the mapping, Asha. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

1) Economic buyer briefing: we’ll prepare a 15-minute commercial overview deck focused on cost, SLA, and rollout plan for Priya. Marcus, if you’re handling contracts we’ll send an MSA + standard SOW for initial review.
2) Security kickoff: Wed 10 Aug 10:00 PT works for our team. Rishi (security lead) and Hiro (infra engineer) will join to review systems boundary and evidence needs.
3) Region/KMS: we support regional routing and can discuss KMS options (customer-managed KMS via our Private deployment or hosted with region pinning). I’ll include a short note on tradeoffs in the deck.

I updated the questionnaire with a few clarifying answers (see attached). If we can get the inventory + a basic network diagram (diagram can be a simple list of endpoints and subnets) before the kickoff, that’ll speed the review.

Attachments: requested_network_diagram_notes.md

Vanessa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinBridge — draft intake & quick confirm on stakeholders

Asha / team — quick technical follow-up ahead of the kickoff: 

1) Scope clarification: from the notes it sounds like the initial integration will NOT persist PII in our pipeline but will store embeddings in a tenant bucket. Please confirm explicitly which of the endpoints in your inventory store customer identifiers or PII (we flagged column "stores_pii").
2) Network diagram: the "simple list of endpoints and subnets" is fine. If you can include whether any endpoints are behind customer-managed VPNs or require egress IP allowlists, include that.
3) Evidence request: for the kickoff, bring any existing SOC2 report or attestations you have; if none, confirm which controls you need us to show (e.g., access controls, encryption-at-rest keys, incident response).

We’ll prepare a short agenda for the 30m call: introductions (5m), systems boundary review (10m), evidence & timeline (10m), action items (5m).

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0433
